svg.title: Auto Switch: seven solder groups, one complete wiring map
svg.desc: Headerless S2 Mini component side up, USB down. Outer right bottom pads are VBUS, GND and GPIO16. Received converter portrait orientation has VOUT top left, GND top right, VIN bottom left and GND bottom right. Four AA cells feed converter input. Meter-verified five volt output supplies controller VBUS and one servo. Grounds are shared; GPIO16 carries PWM signal. Breadboard rail midpoint bridges are shown.
svg.text: Seven pad groups. One complete connection map.
Headerless ESP32-S2 Mini + received XL63070 + switched 4-AA holder + one MG90S
Illustrations enlarged for clarity, not dimensional drawings. Match the labels on your actual boards.
Use only the OUTERMOST right row.
Check actual servo plug colors before connecting.
Each converter group has two joined holes.
Choose one hole per group; do not join neighboring groups.
Leave EN / PS / ADJ and voltage-selection pads
BEFORE CONNECTING THE S2 OR SERVO
Remove cells while soldering. Then power only holder + converter and measure VOUT to GND: target about 5.0 V.
Output selection is NOT verified by this drawing. Switch off and disconnect cells again before completing the wiring.
For USB programming: unplug all three S2 leads from the circuit first. Battery OFF alone does not isolate USB power.
Junctions are dots. Wire crossings with a white gap are not connected. Breadboard rails may differ: check continuity with all power removed.
